description: ResetRequired after a cursor-generation reset (Sections 12.6, 12.7). Status 1 is the sole v1 wire encoding of ResetRequired and the response contains exactly labels 0 and 1; these five bytes are fully determined. The stale cursor value in the request is an example. In the live campaign this probe is obtained naturally — a cursor issued before a genuine generation reset, or a cursor returned by a second relay instance of the same participant — never by forging or injection (ACCEPTANCE Gate G3).
scenario: The relay reset its cursor generation; the peer presents a cursor from the old generation.
